fields.evidence: Dvar_FindHashed chain (0x080b2e54), Dvar_Create bucket push; chunks 029, 102

conflicts: No offset contradiction among the 16 dvar_s definitions; they differ only in how much they name. Size 0x24 is supported by pool arithmetic: pool 0x085abe20 + 0x500*0x24 = 0x085b7220 = hash table address. Contradictions to resolve by renaming, not by layout: chunk_007 calls +0x1c 'next' while chunk_029 calls it sorted_next and has a separate hash_next@0x20; chunk_007 names +0x0c/+0x10 unk0c/unk10 (they are latched/reset); chunk_007 and chunk_100 give min/max as typed unions while chunk_028/029 use raw words (both are the same bits). The legacy alias cvar_s in chunk_009 puts a 'string' pointer at +4 which contradicts flags/type/modified at +4..+7 (only +8 integer is used there). chunk_028 omits +0..+5 and +0x1c/+0x20 (sub-view). Vector dvars (type 2..4) make current/latched/reset pointers into one malloc block of type*12 bytes (current,latched,reset consecutive); strings are shared with canonical literals.
